areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: General objective directly aligned; most specific objectives and indicators tied; large resource share; integrated sanitation, drainage, mobility, housing and public spaces give high expected impact.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Relevant general objective, but works relate only indirectly to environmental conservation; a few indicators fit; impact judged low and adherence restricted.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: Only a specific objective on training and productive inclusion relates; small resource share; moderate impact potential; adherence limited.

bonus.reason: Proponent reported harmony with several PPA priorities, but the NT could not conclude that resources are entirely directed to them.
Proponent did not state the programme promotes regional integration.
